subject: reasoning
question:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statement:Some books are novels.

Some novels are classics.

Conclusions:I. Some books are classics.

II. All classics are books.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56f77b1f7e3c9dc282ac4714761f4ac3c40dceb418c3dd822afcfb6d64fe22a1.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some books are classics. - False (As their is no direct relation between books and classics may be it is possible but not definite. Hence, it is false)**

II. All classics are books.- False (As their is no direct relation between books and classics may be it is possible but not definite. Hence, it is false)

Neither I nor II follows

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"**
